Findings: HLA-DQA1 alleles: 01:04, 02:01. HLA-DQB1 alleles: 05:03, 02:02. DQ2.2-associated alleles detected. A single DQ2.2 haplotype is generally equivocal for celiac susceptibility; a double dose is permissive. Dosage cannot be determined from unphased calls unless homozygosity is evident.
Interpretation: HLA typing indicates genetic predisposition only. It does not diagnose or exclude celiac disease. Clinical interpretation requires serology, biopsy where indicated, and specialist review.
Notes: DQ2.2-defining alleles detected once each, consistent with a single DQ2.2 haplotype. A single DQ2.2 haplotype is generally equivocal for celiac susceptibility, and dosage cannot be fully determined from unphased calls.
